reasoning: This is a CI test suite and benchmarking framework, not an operator, library, service, or configuration project. It provides end-to-end functional tests and benchmarks for AutoX components (AutoRAG and AutoML) running on Red Hat OpenShift AI with Kubeflow Pipelines. The repo contains: (1) autox_tests/ — pytest-based functional test suites that submit real pipeline runs to a RHOAI cluster and validate results (pipeline success/failure, S3 artifacts, notebook execution, KServe model serving), covering both positive and negative scenarios for AutoML tabular, time series, and AutoRAG optimization/indexing pipelines; (2) autox_benchmarks/ — a benchmarking orchestration framework that submits pipeline runs across dataset manifests, collects performance metrics, uploads results to S3, and provides a Streamlit comparison UI; (3) run_tests.sh — a test runner wrapper around uv+pytest with environment file sourcing, suite selection, and DSPA auto-setup. It is designed to be used standalone or embedded as a git submodule in downstream repos. Classification: CI/test-suite and benchmarking framework.
